package handler

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	playerentity "example.com/tower-defense-practice/game/entities/player"
	matchentity "example.com/tower-defense-practice/game/entities/tower_room"
	sender "example.com/tower-defense-practice/game/handler/syncsender"
	tower "example.com/tower-defense-practice/game/towerdefense"
	"fmt"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"sync/atomic"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

type towerGetter map[int64]entity.IThreadSafeEntity

func (g towerGetter) Get(_ context.Context, id int64, _ entity.EntityCategory) (entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	if e := g[id]; e != nil {
		return e, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("entity %d missing", id)
}
func (g towerGetter) GetMany(ctx context.Context, ids []int64, cats []entity.EntityCategory) ([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, error) {
	out := make([]entity.IThreadSafeEntity, len(ids))
	for i, id := range ids {
		v, err := g.Get(ctx, id, cats[i])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out[i] = v
	}
	return out, nil
}

// 仅替换提交器；真实 WAL / Mongo 与 SIGKILL 在独立准入入口验证。
type towerCommitter struct{}

func (towerCommitter) Commit(context.Context, dataengine.CommitRecord) error { return nil }

const towerNow int64 = 1800000000000

type towerFixture struct {
	engine  *nest.NestMgr
	match   *matchentity.TowerRoom
	players [tower.Seats]*playerentity.Player
	ids     [tower.Seats]int64
	clock   atomic.Int64
	rules   tower.Rules
}

func loadTowerRules(t *testing.T, r tower.Rules) tower.Rules {
	t.Helper()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	b, _ := json.Marshal(r)
	if e := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "tower.json"), b, 0600); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	s, e := tower.OpenCatalog(dir)
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	r, e = tower.CaptureRules(s.Current())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return r
}
func newTowerFixture(t *testing.T) *towerFixture {
	t.Helper()
	playerentity.RegisterEntity()
	matchentity.RegisterEntity()
	RegisterTowerDefenseNestHandlers()
	RegisterTickTowerRoomTimerGenNestHandlers()
	f := &towerFixture{rules: loadTowerRules(t, tower.DemoRules())}
	f.clock.Store(towerNow)
	matchentity.TimerDriver.SetClock(func() time.Time { return time.UnixMilli(f.clock.Load()) })
	g := towerGetter{}
	build := func(unique int64, kind entity.EntityKind) entity.IThreadSafeEntity {
		id, e := entity.BuildEntityID(unique, kind)
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		v, e := entity.BuildEntity(&entity.EntityCreateParam{IsCreate: true, Id: id, Kind: kind})
		if e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
		g[id] = v
		return v
	}
	for i := range f.players {
		f.players[i] = build(int64(1000+i), playerentity.EntityKindPlayer).(*playerentity.Player)
		f.ids[i] = f.players[i].ID()
	}
	f.match = build(2000, matchentity.EntityKindTowerRoom).(*matchentity.TowerRoom)
	f.engine = nest.NewEngine(nest.NestOptionWithGetter(g), nest.NestOptionWithTransactionCommitter(towerCommitter{}), nest.NestOptionWithWorkerPools(nest.WorkerPoolConfig{Workers: 2, QueueCap: 128}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}, nest.WorkerPoolConfig{}))
	if e := f.engine.Start(); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e := matchentity.TimerDriver.Bind(f.engine, func(id int64) entity.IThreadSafeEntity { return g[id] }); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		_ = matchentity.TimerDriver.Stop(context.Background())
		_ = f.engine.Shutdown(context.Background())
		f.match.TimerComp().OnDestroy(entity.DestroyReasonMemoryUnload)
	})
	if _, e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).Sync_TowerInit(context.Background(), f.match.ID(), f.ids, f.rules, towerNow); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	for _, id := range f.ids {
		if e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).Sync_TowerPlayerInit(context.Background(), id); e != nil {
			t.Fatal(e)
		}
	}
	return f
}
func (f *towerFixture) state(t *testing.T) tower.State {
	t.Helper()
	s, e := tower.Decode(f.match.Dao().GetState())
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return s
}
func (f *towerFixture) view(t *testing.T, i int) tower.View {
	t.Helper()
	v, e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).Sync_TowerView(context.Background(), f.match.ID(), f.ids[i])
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	return v
}
func (f *towerFixture) command(t *testing.T, i int, kind string, a, b int) tower.Command {
	v := f.view(t, i)
	return tower.Command{Seq: v.Self.NextSeq, Epoch: v.Self.Epoch, Round: v.Round, Kind: kind, A: a, B: b}
}
func (f *towerFixture) send(i int, c tower.Command) (tower.Receipt, error) {
	return sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).Sync_TowerCommand(context.Background(), f.match.ID(), f.ids[i], c, f.clock.Load())
}
func (f *towerFixture) do(t *testing.T, i int, kind string, a, b int) tower.Receipt {
	t.Helper()
	r, e := f.send(i, f.command(t, i, kind, a, b))
	if e != nil {
		t.Fatal(kind, e)
	}
	return r
}
func (f *towerFixture) refuse(t *testing.T, i int, c tower.Command) {
	t.Helper()
	before := f.match.Dao().GetState()
	timer := f.match.Dao().GetWakeTimer()
	if _, e := f.send(i, c); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted invalid command")
	}
	if before != f.match.Dao().GetState() || timer != f.match.Dao().GetWakeTimer() {
		t.Fatal("rejected command changed state or timer")
	}
}
func waitTower(t *testing.T, ok func() bool) {
	t.Helper()
	until := time.Now().Add(8 * time.Second)
	for !ok() {
		if time.Now().After(until) {
			t.Fatal("bounded wait expired")
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
	}
}
func (f *towerFixture) step(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	v := f.view(t, 0)
	f.clock.Store(v.Deadline)
	waitTower(t, func() bool {
		due, ok := matchentity.TimerDriver.DueOf(f.match)
		return ok && due.UnixMilli() == v.Deadline
	})
	if n := matchentity.TimerDriver.DeliverDue(context.Background()); n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("deliver %d", n)
	}
	waitTower(t, func() bool {
		after := f.view(t, 0)
		return after.Phase != v.Phase || after.Round != v.Round || after.Tick != v.Tick
	})
}
func TestTowerDefenseConcurrentCellReservationAndRetry(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	wins := make(chan int, tower.Seats)
	for i := range f.ids {
		c := f.command(t, i, "build", 1, 0)
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			if _, e := f.send(i, c); e == nil {
				wins <- i
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	close(wins)
	winner := -1
	n := 0
	for i := range wins {
		winner = i
		n++
	}
	if n != 1 {
		t.Fatal("same cell had multiple owners", n)
	}
	s := f.state(t)
	if s.Gold != 21 || s.Towers[1].Owner != f.ids[winner] {
		t.Fatal("shared resource double charged")
	}
	r := s.Seats[winner].Receipts[0]
	for range 3 {
		got, e := f.send(winner, r.Command)
		if e != nil || got != r {
			t.Fatal("retry changed receipt", e)
		}
	}
	if f.state(t).Gold != 21 {
		t.Fatal("retry charged again")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseBlockingRouteAndForeignSaleRollback(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	f.do(t, 0, "build", 1, 0)
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "build", 5, 0))
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "sell", 1, 1))
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "build", 0, 0))
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "upgrade", 1, 2))
	f.do(t, 0, "upgrade", 1, 1)
	r := f.do(t, 0, "sell", 1, 2)
	if f.state(t).Gold != 20 || f.state(t).Towers[1].Level != 0 {
		t.Fatal("refund wrong")
	}
	if _, e := f.send(0, r.Command); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if f.state(t).Gold != 20 {
		t.Fatal("refund duplicated")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseReadyDisconnectAndOldConnection(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	s := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine)
	ctx := context.Background()
	f.do(t, 0, "build", 1, 0)
	r := f.do(t, 0, "ready", 0, 0)
	f.refuse(t, 0, f.command(t, 0, "sell", 1, 1))
	if e := s.Sync_TowerConnect(ctx, f.match.ID(), f.ids[1], 1, false); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	f.refuse(t, 1, f.command(t, 1, "build", 6, 0))
	if e := s.Sync_TowerConnect(ctx, f.match.ID(), f.ids[0], 2, true); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if e := s.Sync_TowerConnect(ctx, f.match.ID(), f.ids[0], 1, false); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("old disconnect kicked new connection")
	}
	f.refuse(t, 0, r.Command)
	if got, e := s.Sync_TowerReceipt(ctx, f.match.ID(), f.ids[0], 2, r.Command.Seq); e != nil || got != r {
		t.Fatal("lost receipt", e)
	}
	f.clock.Store(f.view(t, 0).Deadline)
	f.refuse(t, 2, f.command(t, 2, "ready", 0, 0))
	f.step(t)
	v := f.view(t, 0)
	if v.Phase != "battle" || v.Tick != 0 {
		t.Fatal("offline seat stalled wave")
	}
	f.step(t)
	if f.view(t, 0).Tick != 1 {
		t.Fatal("driver did not advance exactly one step")
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseUndoRestoresSharedGoldRouteAndTimer(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	before := f.match.Dao().GetState()
	timer := f.match.Dao().GetWakeTimer()
	c := f.command(t, 0, "build", 1, 0)
	refused := errors.New("after tower construction")
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("tower_undo_build")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		_, e := handlerTowerCommand(es[0].(ITowerRoomEntity), f.ids[0], c, f.clock.Load())
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, e := f.engine.Request(context.Background(), name, f.match.ID(), nil); !errors.Is(e, refused) {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if before != f.match.Dao().GetState() || timer != f.match.Dao().GetWakeTimer() {
		t.Fatal("partial build rollback")
	}
	if _, e := f.send(0, c); e != nil {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
}
func TestTowerDefenseCooperativeVictoryAndAtomicRewards(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	for i, cell := range []int{1, 6, 11, 16} {
		f.do(t, i, "build", cell, 0)
	}
	for i := range f.ids {
		f.do(t, i, "ready", 0, 0)
	}
	if f.view(t, 0).Phase != "battle" {
		t.Fatal("ready barrier failed")
	}
	for range 100 {
		if f.view(t, 0).Phase == "done" {
			break
		}
		f.step(t)
	}
	v := f.view(t, 0)
	if v.Result != "won" || v.Killed != 9 || v.Leaked != 0 || v.BaseHP != 12 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected combat outcome %+v", v)
	}
	before := f.match.Dao().GetState()
	refused := errors.New("after team reward")
	name := nest.NewHandlerName("tower_undo_claim")
	nest.MustRegisterHandlerWithMeta(name, func(es []entity.IThreadSafeEntity, _ []any, _ ...nest.HandlerOption) (any, error) {
		_, e := handlerTowerClaim(es[0].(ITowerPlayerEntity), es[1].(ITowerRoomEntity))
		if e != nil {
			return nil, e
		}
		return nil, refused
	}, nest.HandlerMeta{Rollback: nest.RollbackUndo, Durability: nest.DurabilityStrict})
	if _, e := f.engine.RequestMulti(context.Background(), name, []int64{f.ids[0], f.match.ID()}, nil); !errors.Is(e, refused) {
		t.Fatal(e)
	}
	if f.match.Dao().GetState() != before || f.players[0].Dao().GetGold() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("partial reward rollback")
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for _, id := range f.ids {
		for range 4 {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				got, e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).MultiSync_TowerClaim(context.Background(), id, f.match.ID())
				if e != nil || got != 70 {
					t.Error("reward", got, e)
				}
			}()
		}
	}
	wg.Wait()
	for _, p := range f.players {
		if p.Dao().GetGold() != 70 {
			t.Fatal("duplicate reward")
		}
	}
	waitTower(t, func() bool { _, ok := matchentity.TimerDriver.DueOf(f.match); return !ok })
}
func TestTowerDefenseDefeatNoRewardAndViewCopy(t *testing.T) {
	f := newTowerFixture(t)
	v := f.view(t, 0)
	v.Path[0] = 24
	if f.view(t, 0).Path[0] != 0 {
		t.Fatal("view aliases route")
	}
	if _, e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).Sync_TowerView(context.Background(), f.match.ID(), 999); e == nil {
		t.Fatal("outsider read")
	}
	for range 100 {
		if f.view(t, 0).Phase == "done" {
			break
		}
		f.step(t)
	}
	v = f.view(t, 0)
	if v.Result != "lost" || v.BaseHP != 0 || v.Leaked != 6 {
		t.Fatal("base loss did not finish")
	}
	for _, id := range f.ids {
		got, e := sender.NewTowerDefenseSender(f.engine).MultiSync_TowerClaim(context.Background(), id, f.match.ID())
		if e != nil || got != 0 {
			t.Fatal("defeat rewarded", e)
		}
	}
}
